name: BRANDCORE_PRE_GITHUB_REPOSITORY_CLEANUP
purpose: Conservative cleanup of BRANDCORE before Git initialization. Audit first, remove only clearly disposable files, preserve all source-of-truth documents and M1 evidence, run regression checks, and do not initialize or push Git.
role: Act as a cautious repository maintainer and security-minded build engineer. Inspect every candidate before deletion. Report exact paths and reasons. Never silently delete ambiguous files.

non_negotiable.product_name: BRANDCORE only. Never introduce Sentinel or another product name.
non_negotiable.frontend: React + JavaScript JSX only. TypeScript is prohibited.
non_negotiable.no_git: Do not run git init, git add, git commit, create branches, add remotes, push, create a GitHub repository, or invite collaborators.
non_negotiable.no_cloudflare: Do not log in, create remote resources, deploy, or call Workers AI.
non_negotiable.no_relocation: Do not move or rename the repository. Repository relocation is a separate user action.
non_negotiable.no_dependency_changes: Do not install, remove, update, or resolve dependencies. Do not modify package manifests or lockfiles.
non_negotiable.no_secrets: Never print secret values. Report only file paths and whether secret-like content was detected.

required_inspection: Confirm current path and verify this is the BRANDCORE repository.
Inventory all files and hidden files. Exclude traversal into very large generated directories unless needed for classification.

Read CLAUDE.md, RULES.md, README.md, .gitignore, TASKS.md, MEMORY.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/TOOLING_AUDIT.md, docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md, docs/TEAM_HANDOFF.md, docs/API_CONTRACT.md, docs/TEST_PLAN.md and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.md when present.
Inspect package.json, frontend/package.json, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, wrangler.jsonc, migrations, test configuration, scripts and imports.
Search for references to every proposed deletion candidate before deleting it.
Check M1 evidence for secret-like values without printing contents.
Run the existing test baseline using already-installed tools only. Do not install anything.

must_keep: All T2 security, threat model, secrets policy, testing and deployment documents.
docs/API_CONTRACT.md, docs/TEST_PLAN.md, docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md, docs/TEAM_HANDOFF.md, docs/TOOLING_AUDIT.md and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.md when present.
All application source, tests, configuration, SQL migrations and schema source.
Valid package-lock.json and uv.lock if generated.
.env.example and .dev.vars.example only if confirmed to contain placeholders and no real credentials.
wrangler.jsonc with safe placeholder IDs and documented binding configuration.

safe_delete_only_after_reference_check.reason: Regenerable build output. Confirm the Worker build command recreates it before deletion.
Generated logs only. Preserve anything used as M1 evidence.
Delete only if confirmed to be a local Claude-skill diagnostic, unreferenced by package scripts/docs/runtime, and not part of BRANDCORE.

These are cinematic marketing-site skill materials and not BRANDCORE app requirements. Delete only repository copies that are unreferenced by required project documentation. Never delete installed/global skill copies outside this repository.

never_delete_without_explicit_approval: Application source imported or executed by code, tests, scripts or config.
The eight core documents and T2 security documents.
Environment example files until verified safe.
.wrangler/state or local D1/R2 state, because it may contain useful M1 POC data.

special_security_review.instruction: Inspect whether /api/poc/* is mounted and accessible in deployed Worker environments. These routes may perform D1/R2 test writes. Do not delete POC source or evidence automatically. If exposed, propose the smallest safe fix: remove production route mounting while preserving tests/evidence, or add a verified environment guard. Show exact changes and tests, then stop for Mritunjay's approval before editing or deleting POC routes.

execution_phases.name: Inventory and dry-run classification
actions: Complete all required inspection.
Create docs/evidence/repository-cleanup/cleanup-manifest.md with inventory, classifications, references checked and baseline tests.
Do not delete anything during this phase.
Present SAFE-TO-DELETE and NEEDS-APPROVAL lists separately.
acceptance: Each proposed deletion has an exact path, reason and reference-check result.
No required document, source, migration, test or M1 evidence is proposed for deletion.
Ambiguous files are retained pending approval.

execution_phases.name: Conservative removal
actions: After inventory, remove only confirmed generated caches and OS metadata.
Remove skill-doctor.mjs or cinematic skill copies only if the classification rules are satisfied and there are no project references.
Do not delete node_modules or .venv just to reduce Git size. Leave them on disk and exclude from Git.
Do not delete .wrangler/state or local binding data.
Do not modify /api/poc route exposure without explicit approval.
acceptance: Only clearly disposable files were removed.
No source, test, migration, lockfile or evidence file was removed.
The cleanup manifest records every deletion.

execution_phases.name: Git hygiene
actions: Inspect existing .gitignore and make the smallest precise update.
Ignore generated dependencies, caches, local environments, secrets, Wrangler state, build output and OS metadata.
Allow .env.example and .dev.vars.example.
Do not ignore package-lock.json, uv.lock, migrations or M1 evidence.
Do not use broad patterns that hide source code or documentation.
acceptance: Lockfiles and evidence remain eligible for Git.
Secrets and generated files are excluded.

execution_phases.name: Regression and security checks
actions: Run existing Python tests using existing environment only.
Run frontend build/lint only if dependencies are already installed and scripts exist.
Validate wrangler.jsonc, package manifests and pyproject.toml.
Scan for .ts, .tsx and tsconfig.json.
Scan changed candidates for secrets without displaying values.
Verify imports, scripts and configuration references still resolve.
Verify all M1 evidence remains present.
acceptance: Tests pass or exact failures are documented.
No dependencies were installed or changed.

execution_phases.name: Final readiness report
actions: Report before/after file count and approximate size.
List exact deletions and reasons.
List files left on disk but excluded from Git.
List ambiguous files retained.
Report POC endpoint exposure review and approvals still needed.
Provide Git initialization commands for later but do not execute them.
acceptance: Repository is cleaner without loss of source, evidence or configuration.
No Git repository was initialized and no push occurred.
Every remaining unknown-purpose file is listed.

allowed_without_additional_approval: Delete confirmed generated Python, pytest and Vite caches and OS metadata.
Add specific .gitignore entries after inspecting the current file.
approval_required: Delete any file not clearly generated or not explicitly covered by safe-delete rules.
Delete cinematic skill/reference files if project docs reference them.
Remove or change POC API routes.
Delete evidence, logs with audit value or user-authored documents.

final_report_sections: Before/after file count and approximate size
Files excluded from Git but retained on disk
Secret scan result without exposing values
Confirmation that Git was not initialized and nothing was pushed
completion_rule: Cleanup completes only after a full inventory, exact deletion log, .gitignore review, POC endpoint security review and post-cleanup test report. Do not initialize Git or publish anything.
